tools.name: list_systems
tools.description:
Lists all registered virtual systems in the fleet.

Returns:
    List of SystemMetadata models containing system details.

tools.name: get_system_status
tools.description: Queries detailed status, metrics, and health of a specific system.

system_id.description: Unique string ID of the target system (e.g. 'linux-server-01').

tools.name: execute_system_command
tools.description: Sends lifecycle restarts, Garbage Collection, websocket reconnects or fault injections.

command.description:
Command keyword to execute.
Valid values:
- For Linux: 'REBOOT', 'STOP_NODE_EXPORTER', 'START_NODE_EXPORTER', 'INJECT_FAULT', 'CLEAR_FAULT'
- For Jira: 'RESTART_JIRA', 'GC_CLEANUP', 'EXPAND_DB_POOL', 'EXHAUST_DB_POOL', 'TRIGGER_JVM_LEAK', 'RESET_SIMULATION'
- For Confluence: 'REBOOT', 'RECONNECT_WEBSOCKETS', 'PURGE_ATTACHMENTS', 'DROP_WEBSOCKETS', 'FILL_DISK', 'RESET_SIMULATION'

tools.name: get_system_logs
tools.description: Retrieves recent syslog or application logs for the requested system.

limit.description: Number of recent log lines to retrieve (default: 15).

tools.name: render_system_card
tools.description: Renders a native A2UI v0.8 interactive system operations status card.

system_id.description: Unique string ID of target system.

tools.name: render_system_logs_card
tools.description: Renders a native A2UI v0.8 interactive diagnostics logs card for the target system.

system_id.description: Unique string ID of target system.
